subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving paid subscriptions for your UK music streaming service. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the paid subscription itself, the first confirmed billing on a paid tier, read through a postback held until the first billing cycle clears, so a free signup that never converts never bills against you. At scale that holds around 2,400 paid subscriptions a day at an eCPA of GBP 14, the subscriber quality a partner like Spotify expects. If it helps, I can pull the trial-to-paid read by tier?
angle: warm bump, restate paid-subscription confirmed-billing proof
illustrative_flags: 2,400 paid subscriptions a day at eCPA GBP 14 (MobUpps-specific daily paid-conversion volume and cost-per-paid-subscription, illustrative placeholder)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN subscription_media UK: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to paid subscription = first confirmed billing + s2s postback held to first billing cycle); one illustrative MobUpps figure (2,400/day at eCPA GBP 14); brand named only from candidates (Spotify); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native UK business English; free-to-paid framed positively, no 'X, not Y'; no em dash, no curly quotes.
